card.name: Scattered everyday words in promotional web copy
card.fires_on: Ordinary words in the middle of marketing or explanatory web sentences, such as 'same', 'come', 'years' and 'engineers'. No single word or setting links them.
card.plain: It responds to assorted everyday words in promotional web text, and nothing in common was found across the passages.
